text.en:
Subsection (m) of section six hundred and seventy-one of the-Administrative-Code, as amended
by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and seventy-seven, is amended to read as follows:
"(m) deputy governors and special agents of specially organized provinces."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1939.
